items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Dink Johnson turned around to me and said, "You're fired. We don't need you no more."

ctx.x: And Ernest -- a man playing like that, and you know, Dink Johnson turned around to me and said, "You're fired. We don't need you no more." And that was in the middle of a piece. He wasn't playing nothing but the blues. But that shows you how in that time, even then, you had to be very good at what you were doing or else nobody wanted you.
